newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone forms north of Fiji - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone forms north of Fiji - WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone 33p has formed with 40 mph winds north of the Fiji islands, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Thursday.

The system was expected to strengthen as it tracked south and then southeast during the next 48 hours, and would become an increasing risk to shipping during the next 24-48 hours as winds increased to about 75 mph.
WSC said it was expected to threaten the Fiji islands in a little over 48 hours. Strong winds and heavy rains might move into the islands at that time.
